'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least eight people are killed and more than 28,000 are displaced after [[2026 Pacific typhoon season#Tropical Storm Penha (Basyang)|Tropical Storm Penha]] makes landfall in the southern [[Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tropical-storm-penha-philippines-ad74c018e83fed02e5e341b816e8c237 (AP)]
*An explosion at an [[illegal mining|illegal]] [[coal mining|coal mine]] in [[East Jaintia Hills district]], [[Meghalaya]], [[India]], kills at least 25 people. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/meghalaya-illegal-coal-mine-blast-toll-rises-to-25-two-arrested-101770392902839.html (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://apnews.com/article/india-coal-mine-explosion-meghalaya-95daa1a1b71802fde3314f07d7e5ab64 (AP)]
*Thirteen people are killed and 34 others are injured after a bus carrying wedding guests falls down a 200-meter slope near [[Kathmandu]], [[Nepal]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-bus-crash-mountain-road-35e4d74cef72a60a61a6c04155e39eb9 (AP)]
*Ten people are killed and several others injured after a bus falls down a 100-meter [[ravine]] in [[Eliodoro Camacho Province]], [[Bolivia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bus-plunges-into-ravine-bolivia-killing-least-10-2026-02-06/ (Reuters)]
*At least three people are killed and seven others are injured when a car crashes into a [[99 Ranch Market]] in [[Westwood, Los Angeles|Westwood]], [[Los Angeles]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://abc7news.com/post/least-7-injured-car-crashes-westwood-grocery-store/18548787/ (KGO-TV)]
*One person is killed and three others are injured when a [[double-decker bus]] strikes pedestrians in [[Dublin]], [[Ireland]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/one-dead-three-injured-after-dublin-bus-crash-13503674 (Sky News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[English Channel illegal migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel illegal migrant crossings]]
**[[Angola]], [[Namibia]], and the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] agree to take back foreign offenders and [[Illegal immigration|illegal migrants]] from the [[United Kingdom]] after [[Home Secretary]] [[Shabana Mahmood]] threatened them with [[Travel visa|visa]] penalties. Around 3,000 people are expected to be returned following the deal. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8204g8lejo (BBC News)]
*[[International sanctions against North Korea]], [[United Nations and North Korea]]
**The [[UN Security Council Sanctions Committee on North Korea]] approves exemptions for 17 humanitarian projects in [[North Korea]], allowing [[international organization]]s and [[International non-governmental organization|non-governmental groups]] to deliver [[humanitarian aid]] despite existing restrictions linked to [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction|the country's nuclear program]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/un-security-council-exempt-sanctions-humanitarian-aid-north-korea-source-says-2026-02-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[New START]], the last treaty on [[Nuclear disarmament|limiting]] [[strategic nuclear weapon]]s between [[Russia]] and the United States, expires. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4g31n4ey9go (BBC News)] [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/international-geneva/last-us-russia-nuclear-treaty-expires-whats-at-stake/90886280 (swissinfo)]
**Russia and the United States agree to re-establish high-level military communication for the first time since it was suspended in 2021 under the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-talks-peace-abu-dhabi-witkoff-31ccc70ae7599507bc5a98a6cd87e2aa (AP)]
*The [[Moldova]]n [[Parliament of the Republic of Moldova|parliament]] ratifies the [[United Nations]] [[UNCLOS|Law of the Sea]] Treaty. [https://multimedia.parlament.md/parlamentul-a-ratificat-acordul-privind-conservarea-si-utilizarea-durabila-a-biodiversitatii-marine/ (Parliament of Moldova)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Kidnapping in Nigeria]]
**The remaining 89 people kidnapped from three [[Church (building)|churches]] in [[Kaduna State]], [[Nigeria]], by criminal gangs on January 18, are released. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/remaining-89-kidnapped-nigerian-christians-return-home/ar-AA1VLp0N?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=77b72d1aa29b47caa04f3ed84f25e4fe&ei=42 (Africanews via MSN)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**An [[Azerbaijan]]i [[military court]] sentences 13 former [[Nagorno-Karabakh]] officials, including ex-leader [[Arayik Harutyunyan]], to penalties ranging from 15 years to [[life imprisonment]] after convicting them of offences such as [[war crimes]], [[crimes against humanity]], [[Terrorism in Azerbaijan|terrorism]], [[genocide]], and attempting to [[Coup d'état|seize power by force]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/azerbaijan-hands-long-prison-terms-former-karabakh-officials-2026-02-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**The mayor of [[Tequila, Jalisco]], [[Mexico]], is arrested on charges of alleged [[extortion]] and [[organized crime]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/mexico-arrests-mayor-tequila-extorting-distillers-alleged-cartel-scheme-2026-02-05/ (Reuters)]
